name: AMEREIT
recent: AMEREIT 于 2026 年 10 月 21 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，并宣布每单位 2.19 仙的收入分配。该收入分配的除息日为 2026 年 11 月 5 日，登记日为 11 月 6 日，派发日为 11 月 26 日。此外，公司于 11 月 4 日上市 1,050,565 个新单位，作为 2026 年 7 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日期间的管理费。近期有多名董事及大股东申报持股变动。
notable: 宣布每单位 2.19 仙的收入分配，除息日为 2026 年 11 月 5 日，派发日为 2026 年 11 月 26 日。

recent_en: AMEREIT announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 21 October 2026 and declared an income distribution of 2.19 sen per unit. The ex-date for the distribution is 5 November 2026, entitlement date 6 November 2026, and payment date 26 November 2026. In addition, 1,050,565 new units were listed on 4 November 2026 as management fees for the period from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026. Several directors and substantial shareholders have recently reported changes in their holdings.
notable_en: Declared an income distribution of 2.19 sen per unit, with ex-date on 5 November 2026 and payment date on 26 November 2026.
Listed 1,050,565 new units as management fees for the period from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their holdings, including director Lee Chai's acquisition of 48,300 units in the open market on 11-12 November 2026.
risks_en: The company paid management fees by issuing new units, resulting in an increase in the number of units.
There have been multiple recent filings of changes in holdings by directors and substantial shareholders.
